limitations: Dark-channel correction estimates haze and cannot recover clipped data.
Local extrema, median and bilateral operators use a bounded 7x7 stencil spanning the chosen radius.
Statistical distributions use a deterministic selected-only sample capped at 65536 pixels.
No visual equivalence to Evoto is established.
